method: centrality/cycles/layering computed in-process (Tarjan SCC, iterative) over the git-kb intra-repo call-edge list (4006 non-test edges). public-API derived from symbol visibility. dead-code from git-kb query dead-code-explain scoped to members.
caveat: git-kb resolved 0 call edges under the vendor-inclusive index; edges only resolved after re-indexing member src in isolation. Rust method/trait-dispatch resolution is partial, so in/out-degree is a LOWER BOUND and a few SCCs are same-name-resolution artifacts (flagged).
cycles_note: 4 SCCs of size 2; subscribe<->subscribe, clear<->clear, search<->search are same-name resolution artifacts (two distinct same-named symbols). shutdown<->stop_purge_daemon is a plausible genuine 2-cycle (daemon lifecycle). No large cycles -> graph is effectively a DAG.

layering.declared_boundaries: prompthub (CLI) -> prompt-hub (core); prompthub-server -> prompt-hub (core). Both front-ends depend ONLY on prompt-hub (Cargo path deps); neither depends on the other.
layering.violations_verdict: NONE REAL. All 14 raw "violations" are server test fns -> FuzzyPromptFinder::new in the CLI crate; prompthub-server has NO Cargo dep on prompthub, so these are name-resolution artifacts of `new`. Layering is clean/strict.

dead_code.note: git-kb NoCallers list; inflated by the empty-edge-table problem + Rust trait/test-only usage. Treat as candidates needing manual confirmation, NOT confirmed dead.
